title: Yellow Sauteed Mexican Beans Tacos
description: A sour and shaggy weeknight Mexican dish featuring cinnamon stick, perfect for a quick dinner, this recipe is also shojin-friendly and uses a bamboo steamer as the vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the cooked pinto beans, taco seasoning, and cinnamon stick to the skillet.
Stir well to combine and cook for 5 minutes.
Squeeze the lime juice over the bean mixture and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the bean mixture onto a tortilla and serving immediately.
Steam the tacos in a bamboo steamer for 2 minutes to warm the tortillas and infuse the flavors.
